sloka: इक्ष्वकुवंशविख्यातिं शनैः कीर्तयता ऽनघ ।सा मया नरशार्दूल विश्वासमुपपादिता ।। ५.६५.१५ ।।।।
transliteration: ikṣvakuvaṁśavikhyātiṁ śanaiḥ kīrtayatā 'nagha ।sā mayā naraśārdūla viśvāsamupapāditā ।। 5.65.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "O sinless one O tiger among men To inspire confidence in her I praised the glory of your Ikshvaku dynasty.
